title: Plugins: all together
question: How should the three views fit together? (Tabs work, Install opens the consent dialog)

variants.label: One tab per view
variants.notes: Installed (cards + details), Updates, Browse (marketplace), Security (risk summary + capability grid), Developer (load from folder). Tabs work; Install in Browse opens the consent dialog.

variants.label: Risk on top
variants.notes: Installed opens with the risk summary above the cards, details panel on the right. Browse and Developer as tabs, no separate Security tab. Tabs work; Install in Browse opens the consent dialog.

variants.label: Table first
variants.notes: Installed is the capability table with risk summary and developer box, details panel on the right. Browse as a tab. Tabs work; Install in Browse opens the consent dialog.
